rationale: Planner class (a), autonomous decision rubric 2026-11-07 19:5xZ. The three CLI commands refuse in a cycle for AISDLC-707 (reenter: already in queue/; dequeue: verdict in done/; remove-verdict would make reenter refuse not in done/). retire-by-hand keeps the iterate-needed record, writes the same retired/ record dequeue would, touches one file, and is reversed by moving the file back. remove-verdict-then-plain loses the record and the review-round note and stays held by the open-PR cap; wait-for-1228 parks #2508 behind a task that itself needs a cap slot. Scope: this one move for AISDLC-707 only; AISDLC-1228 (#2513) removes the need.
